findings.fix: Derive and export `volumeFormRaise_apply_left_eq_zero`/`_right_eq_zero`, `volumeFormRaise_self`, `volumeFormRaise_swap`, and an `eq_volumeFormRaise_iff` from `minkowskiProduct_volumeFormRaise` plus `nondegenerate_toBilinForm_minkowskiProduct`.
findings.issue: `volumeFormRaise` is public with no elimination API: no `volumeFormRaise a b a = 0`/`volumeFormRaise a b b = 0`, no `volumeFormRaise a a = 0`, no antisymmetry `volumeFormRaise a b = -volumeFormRaise b a`, no uniqueness lemma. The parallel `transverseEpsRaise` has all of these, so a consumer of the general contraction must re-derive each through nondegeneracy or drop to the four explicit component lemmas.

summary: The two new `@[simp]` Minkowski-side pairing lemmas rewrite past `transverseEps`/`bilinMap`, so the alternation and vanishing simp lemmas of the general theory no longer fire and `simp` stalls on terms like `volumeForm ![k, k, n₊, n₋]` that are zero. `volumeFormRaise` is exported with no elimination API at all (no vanishing on `a`/`b`, no antisymmetry, no uniqueness), unlike its sibling `transverseEpsRaise`.
